description: Hello! I'm Donato, a Systems Engineering and AI student from Peru. 🇵🇪 I'm passionate about software development, Python, data analysis, AI, and environmental technology. I'm developing Amazonia Guardian for NASA Space Apps 2026, focused on MODIS and VIIRS hotspot data. I'm looking for teammates with skills in GIS, data science, AI/ML, environmental science, and UI/UX. Let's collaborate to protect our planet!
